output_list.criticism: The transfer function does not handle large values properly, leading to potential overflow.
Similar to the transfer function, this function lacks checks for large values, leading to potential overflow.
The approve function does not check for overflow when setting the allowance, potentially allowing users to increase allowances without limit.
This function does not check for overflow when increasing the allowance, potentially allowing users to increase allowances arbitrarily.
The decreaseApproval function does not prevent overflow when decreasing the allowance, potentially leading to unexpected behavior.
